description: Unique plot identifier and join key for scoring
Standardized administrative region (Oromia, Amhara, SNNPR, Tigray, Somali)
derivation_formula: Cleaned and standardized via str.strip/title mapping

description: Standardized cultivated crop (barley, maize, sorghum, teff, wheat)
derivation_formula: Cleaned, stripped, lowercase, typo correction (e.g. Tef -> teff)

description: Survey year of observation (2021-2024)
Calendar month the crop was planted (Feb, Mar, Jun, Jul, Aug)
Elevation in meters above sea level
Plot-level self-reported growing-season rainfall in mm
derivation_formula: Median imputed using train median (848.76 mm)

description: Total cultivated farm size in hectares
Chemical fertilizer applied in kg per hectare
derivation_formula: Median imputed using train median (33.83 kg/ha), non-negative clipped

description: Certified improved seed utilized (0 = No, 1 = Yes)
Pest or disease pressure observed (0 = No, 1 = Yes)
Composite soil quality index score (0 to 1)
Labor-days invested per hectare
derivation_formula: Sentinels (-999) replaced and median imputed (45.04 days/ha)

description: Distance to nearest agricultural produce market in km
True harvested crop yield in tons per hectare (TARGET, Train only)
derivation_formula: Target variable, clipped lower bound at 0

description: Mean temperature over 4-month growing season window (deg C)
derivation_formula: Average of monthly avg_temp_c over [planting_month .. +3 months]

description: Total cumulative rainfall over 4-month growing season window (mm)
derivation_formula: Sum of monthly_rainfall_mm scaled proportionally to 4 months

description: Total extreme heat days over 4-month growing season window
derivation_formula: Sum of extreme_heat_days scaled proportionally to 4 months

description: Deviation of season mean temp from region 4-year baseline (deg C)
Count of monthly records available in growing season window (2 to 4)
derivation_formula: Count of valid monthly records matched

description: Market price in Ethiopian Birr per quintal (100 kg)
derivation_formula: Cleaned, unit corrected (*100 for <500 Birr), median imputed

description: Interaction term between fertilizer kg/ha and certified seed flag
Ratio of plot self-reported rainfall to regional station rainfall
Labor days per hectare normalized by farm size
Indicator for main rainy season Meher planting (Jun-Aug)
derivation_formula: planting_month in [Jun, Jul, Aug] (1 = Meher, 0 = Belg)

description: Agro-ecological elevation-to-temperature index
